conversation_log.content:
To start our conversation, I'd love to learn about your background—what first sparked your passion for competitive movement and physical excellence?
Options: [I was a multi-sport athlete growing up | I discovered my passion for a specific discipline later in life | I’ve always been drawn to the mental discipline of high-performance training]
I was a multi-sport athlete growing up

Looking at your current lifestyle, how would you describe your typical weekly commitment to physical training?
Options: [I follow a structured, high-intensity program daily | I train consistently but prefer variety over structure | My activity is regular and intentional, but less focused on formal competition]
I follow a structured, high-intensity program daily

Reflecting on your athletic history and current training, what do you consider to be your greatest natural advantage when you're performing at your peak?
Options: [Explosive speed and power | Exceptional endurance and stamina | Mental resilience and tactical awareness | Versatility across different movements]

scouting_result.pathway_adaptive: Para-Alpine Skiing (e.g., Men's Super-G Sit-Ski LW12)
scouting_result.scout_verdict: Your history as a multi-sport athlete has gifted you with a profound sense of body control that translates beautifully to the icy intensity of the mountain. While your current training emphasizes steady endurance, your 168.0cm and 63.0kg frame offers a low center of gravity—the perfect physical foundation for the precision required in edge-based disciplines. At 29, you are standing at the threshold of your absolute prime, possessing the technical patience to master every turn and the aerobic base to sustain speed through the most grueling downhill sections. Imagine yourself at The Milano Cortina 2026 Games, where every gram of your focus is channeled into the cold, sharp air of the mountainside. The years of structured, high-intensity daily training have refined your mental discipline, allowing you to maintain perfect form under immense G-forces. You aren't just an athlete here; you are an extension of the equipment itself, finding the perfect line that separates a good run from a legendary one.

Though your foundation is built on deep endurance, your biomechanical profile reveals a latent potential for raw, explosive power. At 168.0cm and 63.0kg, your power-to-mass ratio is remarkably efficient, allowing you to generate significant force from the blocks. Your experience as a multi-sport athlete has taught you how to adapt to varying demands, and your commitment to a rigorous daily program provides the neurological fire needed for the world’s fastest discipline. As you step into the stadium for The Brisbane 2032 Games, the focus shifts from the long-game endurance you’ve cultivated to a singular, heartbeat-fast explosion of energy. While some athletes struggle with the mental transition from endurance to sprint, your background in high-performance conditioning ensures your body is primed to handle the physiological peak of the track. You are the architect of your own acceleration, using your hard-won tactical awareness to dismantle the competition in a span of mere seconds.

eval_result.summary: While the narrative incorporates the user's interview answers well, it forces an endurance athlete into a sprint archetype and fails to match the user's gender in the adaptive pathways.

authenticity.reasoning: Matching an athlete whose explicitly stated greatest advantage is 'exceptional endurance' to the 'Block Starter' (100m sprint) archetype is a fundamental physiological mismatch.

personalization.reasoning: The verdicts successfully integrate the user's self-reported background as a multi-sport athlete and their structured daily training regimen into the text.

distinctness.reasoning: The adaptive pathways recommend 'Men's' events for a female user, and the verdicts themselves offer no distinct narrative for the adaptive experience.

interview_quality.reasoning: The final question offers genuinely distinct athletic differentiators (speed vs endurance vs versatility) that should have meaningfully forked the result, even if the pipeline subsequently ignored it.

compliance.note: Clean compliance pass with correctly formatted Games references (The Milano Cortina 2026 Games, The Brisbane 2032 Games).
